name: NumaraAra

search.notes: Per-number pages with user comments and a safety score. Use the national format with a leading 0 and digits only, for example 05XXXXXXXXX.

steps: Choose the subject Numara Silme Talebi (KVKK).
Write the number to delete in the message and cite KVKK Law No. 6698.
Tick the KVKK notice box and submit. The human may need to complete a bot check if one appears.
optout.notes: Türkçe özet. numaraara.com iletişim sayfasında Numara Silme Talebi (KVKK) konusunu seçip numaranızı yazın, talepler 24-48 saatte sonuçlanıyor. The contact page lists bilgi@numaraara.com and the KVKK notice lists destek@numaraara.com. The site says requests are completed in 24 to 48 hours and gives an average reply time of 3 business days.

sources.attribution: NumaraAra contact and KVKK request page
